name: Image-Based Volumetric Shadows
definition: A pixel shader technique that computes downsamples for each pixel, allowing neighboring pixels to share results, using interleaved sampling to determine if a sample position along the view-ray is in scattering or shadow.
summary: Image-Based Volumetric Shadows is a screen-space technique that computes volumetric shadows using image-based primitives and epipolar geometry, avoiding explicit polygon casting.
